title: gitops.application.synced v1 data
description: An ArgoCD Application reached Synced at a revision. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace the object lives in.

revision.description: Git revision (full SHA) the desired state came from.

health.description: ArgoCD health status at the moment of sync. Sync and health are separate facts and a consumer that conflates them will act on a synced-but-degraded app.

syncedAt.description: RFC3339 time ArgoCD recorded the sync. Distinct from the envelope `time`, which is when the bridge published.
